subject: Contrastive RL status - reproduced state-based, image tasks are noisier than advertised
body:
Update ahead of the Jun 19 milestone.

State-based: reproduced. Averaged over the five goal-conditioned tasks we get 71% success vs 63% for our current non-contrastive agent, three seeds, and we did not touch augmentation or add an auxiliary loss. That's the paper's claim and it holds.

Image-based is where it gets interesting. Mean success is still ahead (+6 points) but seed variance is large - one task swings 22 points between seeds. The representation collapses early in maybe one run in six, and when it collapses the inner-product value function is basically flat, so the policy never gets a gradient worth following. Carmen has a fix candidate (temperature schedule on the contrastive loss) but it needs another sweep.

Risk: vulcan is out Jun 22-24, so if we want the extra sweep before your Jun 19 checkpoint I need the decision this week, not next.

Hyun
